# C20 CLI fixtures

Repository-authored Apache-2.0 synthetic CLI cases. The positive passport is
generated by the real C14 evaluator, C18 freshness explanation and C19 passport
builder. Input, rule and evidence bytes reuse the unchanged C14 fixtures; no
scanner, OPA provider, signer, bundle authority or user source is executed.

The `verify` command checks only the versioned passport payload digest. The
passport remains `unverified`; file integrity, signer trust and durable
revision/replay authority are outside C20. `provenance.json` records exact
fixture and reused-input hashes.
